# Image Sources

*2026-05-25 17:25 PDT*

Images used in post 70, 'Seven Required Elements for a zzc Manuscript
report.Rmd'.

All four images were generated via Google Imagen 3 (Gemini) on
2026-05-25. Processed with ImageMagick: `magick <input>.png
-resize 1600x -strip -quality 85 <output>.jpg`.

## Status (2026-08-25)

All four `.jpg` images (already genuine since 2026-05-25) were
confirmed against this README's descriptions and wired into the
`.qmd` (which still referenced the old `.png` filenames with empty
captions). The stale `.png` originals are unused and safe to delete.
No new images were generated for this post.

## hero.jpg

- **Source:** Google Imagen 3 via gemini.google.com
- **Generated:** 2026-05-25
- **Model:** Imagen 3 (Gemini)
- **License:** Generated image, no third-party rights
- **Placement:** Above-fold hero (80% width)
- **Description:** Editorial still life of an open manuscript on a
  plain oak desk, viewed from slightly above. The right margin is
  noticeably wider than the left, a thin metal ruler running along
  its edge. A capped red pen rests diagonally across the lower corner.
  Small printed numerals visible along the left margin (blurred).
- **Metaphor:** A manuscript correctly prepared before it leaves the
  desk -- margins ruled, pages numbered, every element in place.
- **Prompt:** See `_plans/HERO_IMAGE_PROMPTS.md`, Post 70 hero entry.
